title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions built from this week's verified Israel Sports Pulse stories — hoops history, Champions League drama, and Israelis abroad.

questions.question: At the 2001 FIBA SuproLeague Final in Paris, who was named Final Four MVP after Maccabi Tel Aviv's 81-67 win over Panathinaikos?
questions.explanation: Ariel McDonald scored 21 points with 9 assists in the final and was named Final Four MVP as Maccabi won its first European title in 20 years.

questions.question: Who scored Hapoel Be'er Sheva's goal in their 1-0 first-leg win over Red Star Belgrade in Champions League qualifying?
questions.explanation: Zahi Ahmed scored the only goal, in the 38th minute, in a first leg played at a neutral venue in Szombathely, Hungary, despite Hapoel finishing with ten men.

questions.question: What is Adva Cohen's personal best and Israeli national record in the women's 3,000m steeplechase, set at the 2025 World Championships in Tokyo?
questions.explanation: Cohen's 9:19.90 from Tokyo 2025 remains her PB and the Israeli record, and she carried that form into an eighth-place heat finish (9:37.15) at the 2026 Europeans in Birmingham.

questions.question: At the 2026 European Aquatics Championships, which Israeli swimmer broke his own national record with a 1:45.59 opening leg in the men's 4x200m freestyle relay?
questions.explanation: Loktev's 1:45.59 leg broke his own Israeli record of 1:46.17 and stood as the meet's first Israeli national record, as the relay finished 7th overall in 7:07.55.

questions.question: Which English second-tier club did winger Manor Solomon join this summer, setting up an all-Israeli Carabao Cup derby against Daniel Peretz's Southampton?
questions.explanation: West Ham signed Solomon from Tottenham for a reported £7m, and the newly relegated Championship club was then drawn against Southampton, who had signed goalkeeper Daniel Peretz from Bayern Munich.
